recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future Genotype profile corrections, including any later coordinate/location refinements, should be made in HL7/genomics-reporting or the published Genomics Reporting IG unless the Clinical Genomics work group explicitly moves this content back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-14315 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Observation request to create a Genotype profile under Observation-genetics with derivedFrom Haplotype, code 84413-4, valueString, gene-studied 48018-6, and GenomicLocation component grouping; the resolution said it was already applied as the Genotype profile in the Genomics Reporting IG.
initial_application: No current FHIR-core commit explicitly applies FHIR-14315 as a core profile. CG WGM minutes accepted FHIR-14315 with sibling profile issues as already applied to the Genomics Reporting IG, not Observation-genetics in FHIR core; later core history removed old Observation-genetics artifacts in commit 3cfe12f1b4037e4fe922af288ba96fa49faf1435.
additional_context: Current core has active Observation/profile build configuration but no active Observation-genetics/Genotype profile source or current core source for the requested 84413-4 and 48018-6 constraints. Core Observation, DiagnosticReport, and genomics narrative links direct implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG. The published Genomics Reporting IG package hl7.fhir.uv.genomics-reporting 3.0.0 contains an active Observation Genotype profile with the requested code, value, derivedFrom, and gene-studied constraints. Legacy observation-genetics extensions in the Extension Pack are retired/deprecated and point to the Genomics Reporting Guide.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source files were changed. The external-repo audit commit records that recreating the old Observation-genetics Genotype profile in core would be outside current build scope and contrary to the accepted external-IG disposition.
